question: The volume (in m³) of a cube, each of whose edges is 25 m, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **cube** with edge **a**, the **Volume** = **a³**.

Given **edge (a)** = 25 m.

Volume = 25 × 25 × 25 = 625 × 25 = 15,625 m³.

**∴ The correct answer is 15,625 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Edge of the cube (a)** = 25 m

**Formula Used:**

**Volume of a Cube** = (Edge)³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/141f86a8909bbed02aefc09b2ae6a77b009dd72fa53e3b15fce0c78555248148.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = 25 m × 25 m × 25 m

⇒ Volume = 625 × 25 m³

⇒ Volume = 15,625 m³

**∴ The correct answer is 15,625 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cube

The total area of all six faces is given by 6 × a².

Lateral Surface Area of Cube

The area of the four side faces is given by 4 × a².

Diagonal of a Cube

The longest distance between two opposite corners is √3 × a.</p
